programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: the ghostbusters
programme.desc: Dr. Peter Venkman (Bill Murray) takes advantage of his research scholarship at the University to torture boys and conquer girls who take psychosensory tests. He is actually a very capable scientist who resorts to logic rather than superstition, but he uses the girls' gullibility to flirt with them. His friends, Dr. Raymond Stantz (Dan Aykroyd) and Dr. Egon Spengler (Harold Ramis), carry out ectoplasmic studies to investigate the possible existence of ghosts and even capture one for later study. The first time they have a warning about the real presence of a ghost in a library, they don't know how to deal with it and run away. It is after they are kicked out of the University that they decide to mortgage Stantz's house and start their own ghost hunting company. Over time they manage to develop machines that trap ectoplasmic beings for later study. But the jobs that come to the office are nonsense with what is about to fall on them. A young woman who lives alone begins to have truly shocking paranormal experiences in her home and decides to call the Ghostbusters to help her. The investigation will take them further than they ever thought they would go, seeing things they would never have dreamed of seeing. In Aykroyd's original script, the story took place in a future where there would be teams of ghostbusters like there are today of paramedics or firefighters. But the budget studied for that type of film amounted to three hundred million dollars and Aykroyd was forced to adapt it to the scientific reality of the 1980s. Initially other actors were going to play some of the most important roles in the film: John Candy was going to be Louis Tully, John Belushi was going to be Dr. Peter Venkman, and the role of Winston was written specifically for Eddie Murphy.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish is a boy who accidentally finds a board game called Jumanji and convinces his friend Sarah to try it, but very strange events begin to occur and the game will catch them and change their lives. By throwing the dice, Alan is transported to a parallel world, where he will not be able to leave until the game ends, but circumstances cause Sarah to leave and Alan is trapped for 26 years in that other world until two new children find the game and start playing.

programme.title: The jewel of the Nile
programme.desc: Jack and Joan are about to get married on a boat on the high seas. But suddenly a horde of pirates attack them and set fire to the facilities. Joan and Jack fight off the tenacious pirates when they realize there is only one place left on the lifeboat. Joan asks Jack to take care of it since she is going to die soon of tuberculosis and it is not worth the man dying. When he leaves she wonders what the buccaneers will do and what her future will be... But this incredible adventure was only part of Joan Wilder's fantasy with which she intends to start writing her new book, in which she is stuck. She has been married to Jack Colton for some time and after the incredible adventures they have had, they find themselves stuck in a port in the south of France bound for Greece, although she would prefer to go to New York. That same afternoon, at a book signing, Joan meets Omar, a benevolent ruler of an Eastern country called Kadir. He invites her to his palace so she can feel like a queen while he writes, but Jack is not amused by this proposal. Quarreled, they decide to separate and take some time while she finishes her book. Suddenly, Joan witnesses how a man named Tarak tries to murder Omar in front of her. For his part, Jack meets a man named Ralph at the port who seeks revenge for his time spent in prison. They both see how a man approaches: it is Tarak, the murderer, who comes to ask them for help. He confesses to them that Omar is actually a horrible dictator who has stolen their most precious treasure, "The Jewel of the Nile." Jack decides to help him when he sees his ship explode and understands that the sheikh intended to kill him and thus, in the process, rescues his wife. But the sheik has great power and it will be very difficult for Jack and Ralph to get their way. The actors who play the tribesmen: Arak, Barak, Karak, Sarak and Tarak, the same ones from the troop of jugglers in The Brothers Karamazov.

programme.title: my sister's husband
programme.desc: Richard is a Cambridge professor who will find himself involved in an unexpected love triangle. After getting a young and attractive American student pregnant, he will also meet her sister, an eccentric novelist.

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: A very dangerous alien has escaped from the high-security prison on the Moon with the help of his exuberant admirer. The alien is called "Boris the Animal", a ruthless being that Agent K. captured in 1969 and whom they must face again. Unaware of Boris's escape, K. (Tommy Lee Jones) and J. (Will Smith) continue carrying out their work as M.I.B. agents. ridding the city of dangerous aliens or aliens with petty crimes. At the beginning of a new day, J. can't find his partner anywhere, but that's not the most worrying thing, no one at the agency seems to know of his existence. In his investigation he will realize that Boris has made a jump in time and has killed K. completely changing history and causing the Earth to be unprotected against an imminent alien attack. J. will have to travel back in time to recover his partner and save the future of the planet. Specifically, he will travel to the year 1969, when K. is still a young agent with a certain sense of humor. Together they will try to catch the evil Boris. To do this, they will have the intermittent and relative help of a character who is capable of seeing all the space-time lines of the Universe at every moment. The film began filming without a definitive script, so production was delayed due to all the rewrites that were done until it was completed. For the role of Boris, the participation of actor Sacha Baron Cohen, known for his leading roles in the films "Borat" and "The Dictator", was reconsidered. But in the end the role was awarded to Jemaine Clement. The makeup he wore to embody the alien took four and a half hours to apply each day of filming. Will Smith had his ups and downs with the film's director, Barry Sonnenfeld, because he wanted the person to play the role of the colonel's son to be his son, Jaden Smith, and not Cayen Martin, who ultimately got the role.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: During an interstellar trip, a space freighter breaks down and has to make an emergency landing on a mysterious planet. The survivors will have to face some strange creatures. A very dangerous assassin, Riddick, who was part of the charge, flees the place, leaving the survivors in danger of nocturnal creatures that come to the surface when the planet's three suns are darkened due to an eclipse.

programme.title: John Q
programme.desc: John Q. Archibald is an ordinary man, who works for hours in a factory to support his family. John lives focused on his wife Denise and his son Michael, to whom he dedicates practically all of his time. Everything goes wrong when their son falls ill and the hospital tells them that he needs a heart transplant as soon as possible, otherwise he will die. The child does not have medical insurance that covers the intervention, so he is outside the allocation plan and the prognosis is very negative. Seeing how his son awaits the fatal outcome and without money with which to face the operation, John decides to make a decision that may save his life, even if it involves breaking some limits.

programme.title: Llamaradas
programme.desc: He was a child when he witnessed the death of his father in an act of service during a fire. Twenty years later, Brian is also a firefighter in Chicago. He is in a difficult trial period led by his brother Stephen who is very demanding of him. Both brothers will try to overcome disputes and memories of the past while an arsonist sets fires in the city.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Better... impossible
programme.desc: Melvin Udall is a novelist with obsessive-compulsive disorder that, among other things, causes him to walk down the street without stepping on sidewalk lines or to use new cutlery every time he eats. But Melvin also feels proud of his ability to offend and irritate others, especially his neighbor Simon Nye, a homosexual artist whom the writer always attacks with his viperous tongue. Melvin has breakfast every day in a cafeteria and there is only one waitress who can put up with him, Carol, a single mother struggling to raise her asthmatic son. The fate of these characters will be intertwined because of a dog and a trip.

programme.title: A doctor in the countryside
programme.desc: After 30 years working as the only doctor in a small village in a rural area of ​​southern France, Jean-Pierre falls ill. Health problems remove the doctor who attended, cured and cared for his neighbors from the profession 365 days a year and at any time. That is why it is necessary for another person to move in to replace him during sick leave. At that moment, Nathalie, a young doctor who has just finished her residency and who also has extensive experience as a nurse, arrives in the village. She will be in charge of helping Pierre with his work when he can't, but it will be a professional challenge because she has never worked in a medical office in a small town. In this way, it will also be complicated for Jean-Pierre because for him his work is the most important thing, so he will have to learn to deal with his new partner.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Mutiny on board
programme.desc: In 1787, the ship Bounty made a dangerous journey of 50,000 kilometers. After a month of sailing under strong storms, Captain William Bligh allows the crew to dock on a remote island so that they can rest. After seeing the situation of lack of control among the sailors, the captain insists on returning to the boat to continue his trip. However, the second in command, Fletcher Christian, will support his men.

programme.title: the ghostbusters
programme.desc: Dr. Peter Venkman (Bill Murray) takes advantage of his research scholarship at the University to torture boys and conquer girls who take psychosensory tests. programme.title: The Blind Side (A possible dream)
programme.desc: A young homeless African-American finds refuge in a white family, who will support him in his desire to become an American football player. Based on true events, the film tells the story of Michael Oher (Quinton Aaron), a teenager who tries to survive on his own, practically "homeless" until Leigh Anne Tuohy (Sandra Bullock) finds him on the street. Upon discovering that he is his daughter's classmate, he decides to take him home. Little by little, Michael will become part of the family. Sandra Bullock won an Oscar for best actress for her performance and the film was a success at the American box office.

programme.title: Absolute power
programme.desc: Luther, a specialist in grand thefts, plans to rob the mansion of a tycoon who is on vacation in the Caribbean. However, the victim's wife appears unexpectedly.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Dr. Franks is a prestigious neurosurgeon who is going to carry out a unique and very dangerous operation: implant the memories, secrets and abilities of CIA agent Bill Pope who has just died in the mind of another person. This is a cutting-edge method that is presented as the only way the agency has to recover confidential information of vital importance from Pope's memory that compromises the national security of the United States. The problem is that the only candidate to become the vessel of the deceased's mind is Jericho Stewart, a dangerous and unpredictable convict who is on death row awaiting execution and who has a brain abnormality that makes him perfect for the mission. However, no one can assure that the result is the most effective way to stop a terrible conspiracy that is hanging over the country.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Last Kiss
programme.desc: A German officer is sent to Holland to determine whether the British Secret Service has infiltrated the home of Kaiser Wilhelm II during the start of World War II, but begins a dangerous and lethal romance with a young Dutch Jew with consequences neither of them could have foreseen.

programme.title: The client
programme.desc: Mark Sway is an eleven-year-old boy who witnesses the death of a mafia lawyer. Before dying, he confesses some very important information to him. But, fearing retaliation, Mark doesn't dare tell the FBI. The FBI pressures Mark to reveal the lawyer's last words, but he, aware that the mafia is watching him, decides to hire a lawyer to protect him. Adaptation of the best seller of the same name by John Grisham, directed by Joel Schumacher (''A Day of Fury'', ''Batman Forever''). Its plot starting point is vaguely reminiscent of that of ''Sole Witness'', although the Mormon community that surrounded Harrison Ford in Peter Weir's film is replaced here by a single character: that of a devoted lawyer. For this reason, the true core of the film, despite being a thriller, is not the judicial plot, but the relationship established between the boy, played by Brad Renfro (chosen from 5,000 candidates), and his lawyer, a role entrusted to Susan Sarandon, for which she was nominated for an Oscar for best actress. Tommy Lee Jones gave life to the third party, in the shoes of an ambitious prosecutor.

programme.title: Deuda de sangre
programme.desc: When Terry McCaleb is called to a crime scene where his partners Detective Waller and Arrango are waiting for him, he can't imagine how events will unfold. Victims five and six of the latest series of murders await him, and on a wall is written in blood "McCaleb, fuck me if you can" and a number code. As Terry tries to avoid giving answers to the reporters, he encounters one with blood on his shoes. He will chase him but when he almost catches him, he suffers a heart attack and falls to the ground. The suspect approaches and looks at him and Terry shoots him in the fog he sees without knowing if he has really wounded him. 2 years later, Terry is going to have some tests after his heart transplant. His doctor, Dr. Fox, gives him the all-clear before the retired agent goes to his ship, where he meets Graciella Rivers. The woman wants to hire him to investigate the disappearance of her nephew: Raymond. He also tells him that the heart that Terry has received is from Graciella's own sister. The next day the retired agent will meet with his former colleagues, who show him a security tape of a small store where there has been a murder. Even though it is prohibited, Terry will go there to ask questions to begin his investigation until he comes to the conclusion that the store robbery and murder has to do with another that occurred recently. As the investigation continues, Terry's stress increases, causing his recent transplant to hurt more and more. But the murders are there and the former agent is convinced that he will be able to find a relationship between all of them that will bring to light the culprit. This Clint Eastwood film exists in the same universe as "The Innocent." But despite his most famous roles playing Dirty Harry and other cops, this FBI agent is the last of Clint's incarnations as a detective.

programme.title: The agent
programme.desc: In the year 2030, the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and faces serious environmental problems as a result of global warming. All those citizens who are unproductive are exiled to a colony.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in the Philippines, "Platoon" tells us about the year a young university student named Chris spends in a regiment, who decides to volunteer in the Vietnam War. First part of a trilogy directed and written by Oliver Stone about the Vietnam War (followed by Born on the Fourth of July and Between Heaven and Earth). The protagonist of this story is a young Charlie Sheen, accompanied by a cast among which we highlight Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger or some at that time still unknown Forest Whitaker or Johnny Depp. "Platoon" was the first film about Vietnam written and directed by a veteran of that war. Oliver Stone created this masterpiece taken from the experiences that he himself lived on the battlefield in his year as a soldier, filming almost a documentary where he tells us in first person through a character named Chris all his experiences in Vietnam. We are thus witnessing one of the most precise and realistic war films that recount this conflict with excellent direction, a script and impeccable editing. As for the exteriors, they are very well detailed and this perfection makes the viewer quickly immerse themselves in the war atmosphere that surrounds everything without rest. Definitely, a spectacular film that shows what until then Hollywood always tried to hide and the best way to get closer to what those days in Vietnam really were. Classic of the eighties and universal cinema.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: Young JR is accused and imprisoned for a minor crime. When he enters prison he discovers the harshness of life in prison, but he will soon become the protégé of Brendan Lynch, one of the most dangerous prisoners in Australia. However, that protection will have a price and Lynch, along with his team, will have plans for JR when he is released from prison: help them with their escape plan.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War broke out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that allows it to capture the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: natural born killers
programme.desc: Mickey and Mallory are two young people who, in love and maddened, murder the girl's father in cold blood and begin a flight. The host of a sensational program decides to take advantage of the fascination that his personality exerts on the public to turn the murderers into television heroes.

programme.title: The law of the street
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy joins a gang in Washington, but he is determined that his 10-year-old brother will not follow in his footsteps. Everything indicates that this will be his destiny, until he meets a war veteran.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: I continue like God
programme.desc: Popular Buffalo reporter Evan Baxter has just become a congressman, so he moves with his family to a luxurious development in Huntsville, Virginia. Everything seems to be going well for the Baxter family, who are focused on adjusting to their new luxury-filled life away from their hometown. Evan is expectant since in his first days as a congressman, the powerful Congressman Long proposes that he work together with his team in the development of a bill, which makes him think that God has heard his prayers and that professional success has finally knocked on his door. However, Evan's future begins to falter when one day a man who calls himself God appears at his house and entrusts him with an important mission of biblical proportions: build an ark to save a pair of each animal species and thus save humanity from the approaching universal flood. Even though Evan is skeptical and considers the man crazy, when pairs of all kinds of animals begin to arrive in his garden and different suppliers begin to knock on his door bringing enormous quantities of wood and other materials, Evan is forced to believe in God and forcibly accept the order. Resigned and with the help of his three children and the manual 'Build Arks for Dummies', Evan begins his important task. During the process, many will consider Evan crazy and begin to call him 'The Noah of New York' as he will undergo a significant transformation, both physically and mentally.

programme.title: Matar a Santa
programme.desc: Chris, also known as Santa Claus, is forced to team up with the military to save his business. To make matters a little worse, he finds himself involved in a deadly battle against a hitman hired by a 12-year-old boy.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sweet Molly Wright has a life-changing experience as a child; Help an alien who is being sought by two agents of the MiB organization escape. Twenty years after what happened, and after much physical and intellectual preparation, she manages to present herself as a candidate to join the CIA and the FBI, but no one believes her story and she is rejected for her delusions with alien life. Despite this, Molly does not give up and manages to track down an alien landing that leads her directly to the MiB headquarters in New York City. His adventure begins from that moment, he leaves life as he knows it behind and becomes a testing agent for the MiB branch in the city of London. The tenacious and cunning Molly has to prove her abilities to stay in the MiB. To do this, he manages to get involved in a difficult mission as the assistant of the presumptuous agent H. Both agents will have to iron out their rough edges and work as a team to solve two serious problems; the appearance of a mole that would call into question the impeccable reputation of the MiB and the threat of two alien beings that endangers life on Earth and the balance of the universe. Men in Black: International is a new installment of the famous Men in Black franchise. It becomes the fourth film and spin-off of the original MIB saga. It stars Chris Hemsworth, Tessa Thompson and Liam Neeson and much of its filming took place in the cities of New York, Morocco, Italy and London. The actor and producer Felix Gary Gray was in charge of directing this film.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: The flight
programme.desc: Commander Whip Whitaker is forced to make an emergency landing of the aircraft he is piloting, thereby saving many lives. He is considered a hero, until the subsequent investigation reveals that he had used narcotics the night before the incident. The pilot faces a trial in which he must put his career and his own life in order.

programme.title: Tech Now
programme.desc: Andrew Rogers has the highlights from the Esports World Cup in Paris. Laura Cress learns how to build a gaming PC. Shiona McCallum explores how AI is reshaping job recruitment. And Ammie Sekhon finds out why medical students are practising with AI-powered virtual patients.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: Clive travels to the Dominican Republic’s capital city, Santo Domingo, where baseball is a way of life. He meets one of the country’s top scouts, who gives him much-needed advice on his swing. On the outskirts of town, Clive encounters a congregation practising a hidden religious faith, while in the historic old town, he meets artisans who are reviving intricate, traditional craftwork. Then, he heads to the market with one of the country’s top chefs to pick up the ingredients for a seven-meat Dominican dish.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: An AI-generated actor called Tilly Norwood has been cast in the lead role of a forthcoming film, adding to the debate about artificial intelligence in filmmaking. The announcement follows criticism from actors such as Emily Blunt, and objections from the US performers' union. Eline Van der Velden, founder and CEO of Particle6, explains why she created Tilly Norwood, while Jake Kanter, international investigations editor at Deadline, sets out the reaction from the film industry. Andy Burnham has become the UK's new prime minister, and his approach to the media is already attracting attention. His team has relied more on social media, online creators and direct communication than on traditional broadcast interviews. Lizzy Buchan, political editor of the Daily Mirror; Jennifer Gerber, senior political advisor, WA Communications; Tom Nicholas, creator of the Slow News Day YouTube channel; and broadcaster Andrew Neil, presenter of The Andrew Neil Report, assess what this could mean for political journalism and public accountability.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: It's an important year for the city of Hull, in northern England. It's celebrating more than 800 years of maritime history with a raft of new museum openings that it's hoped will make it a world-class visitor attraction. Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to see the opening of the restored Spurn Lightship - literally a lighthouse on a ship - which was a mainstay on the waterways there for 50 years. She meets the people involved in the huge regeneration effort and finds out why the city's been the punchline of jokes for so many years.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Just how long can Iran afford to keep fighting the US? War is expensive, and Iran's economy is facing recession as people struggle with soaring prices, rising unemployment and a weak currency. But with the fighting continuing, are years of international financial sanctions really having the desired impact? Professor Djavad Salehi-Isfahani, a leading expert on Iran's economy, tells us what he found on a recent visit to Tehran, and Mark Wallace, CEO of campaign group United Against a Nuclear Iran, explains the realities of sanctions. Plus, Ben Thompson also hears from Tom Broughton, founder of London glasses brand Cubitts, about how he's taking on the big names in a multi-billion dollar industry.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: An AI-generated actor called Tilly Norwood has been cast in the lead role of a forthcoming film, adding to the debate about artificial intelligence in filmmaking. The announcement follows criticism from actors such as Emily Blunt, and objections from the US performers' union. Eline Van der Velden, founder and CEO of Particle6, explains why she created Tilly Norwood, while Jake Kanter, international investigations editor at Deadline, sets out the reaction from the film industry. Andy Burnham has become the UK's new prime minister, and his approach to the media is already attracting attention. His team has relied more on social media, online creators and direct communication than on traditional broadcast interviews. Lizzy Buchan, political editor of the Daily Mirror; Jennifer Gerber, senior political advisor, WA Communications; Tom Nicholas, creator of the Slow News Day YouTube channel; and broadcaster Andrew Neil, presenter of The Andrew Neil Report, assess what this could mean for political journalism and public accountability.

programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: The Yellow River - running for almost five and half thousand kilometres from west to east - is known as China's mother river. It's hailed as the cradle of Chinese civilisation and over thousands of years, it has fed billions of people and inspired generations of artists. Alastair explores the Yellow River and discovers some of the finest artwork from its valley, to understand how this unique natural phenomenon is deeply connected with the identity of the Chinese and the roots of their culture.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.desc: Jack seorang pencuri yang sedang menjadi buron. Suatu ketika ia merampok sebuah rumah dan mengambil satu peti mewah. Ia mengira itu adalah peti yang memuat perhiasan serta uang banyak. Apakah isi didalam peti tersebut?

programme.title: Hijab Yang Tertukar

programme.title: Misteri Sosok Sang Ibu

programme.title: Salon Madam : Rambut Api
programme.desc: Seorang wanita datang ke Salon Madam untuk mengecat rambutnya dan mempercantik penampilannya, tapi cantik itu luka, dan rambutnya bisa menjadi petaka membara jika tak digunakan dengan bijak.

programme.title: Dari Nada Turun Ke Hati
programme.desc: Prisa, seorang mahasiswi baru jurusan musik, sedang berusaha mencari partitur lagu yang akan dimainkannya saat Ujian Akhir Semester. Dia pun berangkat ke sebuah perpustakaan musik dan bertemu Edwin.

programme.title: Kembalikan Tubuhku
programme.desc: Dinda dan Marsya mengalami sebuah kecelakaan. Kejadian ini membuat Marsya dan Dinda bertukar tubuh. Dinda masuk ke tubuh Marsya dan menggunakan tubuhnya. Namun justru permasalahan baru dimulai. Bagaimanakah kisahnya?

programme.title: Putri Salju Van Betawi
programme.desc: puteri adalah seorang gadis yang dibuang dan akan dibunuh oleh Ibu tirinya sendiri. Dia akhirnya ditemukan dan dibesarkan oleh seorang jawara betawi yang melatihnya menjadi seorang gadis pesilat handal.

programme.title: Kesengsem Tukang Sedot WC
programme.desc: Dika, seorang tukang sedot WC yang tampan, yang terlibat masalah dengan atasan barunya, anak perempuan pemilik perusahaan yang ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki dugaan penyelewengan dana perusahaan.

programme.title: Herry Porter Pembawa Cinta
programme.desc: Maya mencari kerja di Bandung dan tinggal di rumah budenya. Maya pun diterima bekerja di sebuah toko textil. Heri, seorang porter, bekerja di tempat yang sama. Mereka kerap bertengkar, tapi perlahan mereka menjadi dekat.

programme.title: Terdampar Di Pulau Kosong
programme.desc: Tomi mengajak teman-teman sekelas liburan di sebuah pulau.Tomi ajak Hani jalan-jalan dengan speedboat. Ditengah laut speedboat hilang kendali. Tomi menyelamatkan diri sendiri dan Hani ditinggal terdampar di pulau tak berpenghuni.

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik dan ia bersembunyi di hutan.

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik dan ia bersembunyi di hutan.

The Brave Archer

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Aktris muda Linda Lin Dai tampil memukau sebagai seorang gadis desa yang menjalin hubungan gelap dengan Kaisar Cheng-Te, pria yang ia cintai seumur hidupnya.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng adalah salah satu dari 'Flying Guillotine Squad', sekelompok pembunuh yang ditugaskan oleh Kaisar Yung. Saat ia mulai mempertanyakan moralitas misinya, ia menjadi buronan yang diburu oleh mantan rekan-rekannya.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Chen Hou adalah seorang sopir yang terjebak dalam skandal salah identitas yang membawanya pada pebisnis wanita Lok Dai. Saat rumor menyebar bahwa mereka berpacaran, Lok Dai pun marah dan meminta penjelasannya.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang pendekar pedang muda ditugaskan memimpin perkumpulan rahasia patriotik demi melawan jenderal pengkhianat yang berkolusi dengan musuh. Lalu, ia bertemu dengan seorang prajurit wanita dan dua putri cantik.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Dua pemuda bergabung dengan kelompok pemberontak setelah Revolusi Tiongkok tahun 1911 dan tak sengaja menjadi pahlawan. Dibantu oleh seorang putri panglima perang, mereka berhasil membantu pemberontak mencuri senjata.

programme.title: Tales Of A Eunuch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang perjuangan seorang berandal terkenal, yang gemar berjudi dan terlibat masalah dengan para penjahat dan pemberontak, dalam mencari sebuah naskah khusus Buddha.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Dalam film fantasi nan menawan ini, Lin Dai berperan sebagai seorang dewi yang jatuh cinta pada seorang pria terpelajar. 14 tahun kemudian, putra mereka berusaha menguak misteri tentang jati dirinya.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing menciptakan genre film perjudian hampir sendirian, dan dalam salah satu film laris awalnya, Shih Hsien memimpin pemeran bintang dalam kisah tentang mata-mata, taipan, dan gadis cantik.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: Opera Huangmei yang epik ini dibintangi oleh Li Li-hua dan Ivy Ling Po dalam kisah tentang seorang pelayan Istana yang menyerahkan putranya yang baru lahir, demi menyelamatkan sang pangeran dari seorang pejabat jahat.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

To create a real garden, Alan designs an inward-looking intimate area surrounded by beautiful year-round colour for Roy and Eileen to enjoy - at the same time, Katie Rushworth is inspired by the couple's love of blues and pinks to plant a wrap-around border and building a covered seating area. Meanwhile, Frances Tophill is tasked with breaking up the vast expanse of fence with clever architectural planting and raised beds, and she must also design a bin store with living roof too - elsewhere, David Domoney heads to Wappenham Manor in Northamptonshire, where the front garden has been transformed into the most spectacular formal garden to welcome the owners home.

programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

Her parents and friends became increasingly worried and reported her missing - on the 28th of November, 2020, a rubbish truck driver spotted a naked body dumped in the gutter of a side road in Houston. programme.title: On The Line (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seo-joon kehilangan segalanya akibat penipuan suara (voice phishing) dan menyusup ke sebuah organisasi di Tiongkok untuk bertemu dengan Kwak Pro, perancang di balik sistem penipuan tersebut.

programme.title: I, The Executioner (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Detektif pemula Park Sun Woo dan Seo Do-Cheol, seorang veteran dari tim Divisi Penyelidikan Kejahatan Kekerasan, mengejar seorang pembunuh berantai yang mengguncang dunia mereka.

programme.title: Second Sister (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: So-eun, yang sedang berduka setelah kakaknya bunuh diri akibat pelecehan seksual dan cyberbullying, bekerja sama dengan seorang detektif swasta bernama Jun-gyeong untuk mengungkap kebenaran kelam di balik rumor-rumor jahat tersebut.

programme.title: Life Is Beautiful
programme.desc: Se-yeon, yang mengabdikan seluruh hidupnya untuk keluarganya, tiba-tiba menderita penyakit yang sangat parah. Kini, ia bertekad untuk menjalani hidup dengan baik dan mencari cinta pertamanya dengan bantuan suaminya.

programme.title: The Snitch
programme.desc: Dalam lingkaran kejahatan narkoba, informan 'Ya-Dang' menjual informasi kriminal. Penjahat menggunakannya untuk mengurangi hukuman, sementara penegak hukum menggunakannya untuk penangkapan. Ya-Dang, polisi, dan jaksa membentuk segitiga kunci.

programme.title: Honey Sweet
programme.desc: Chi-ho adalah seorang perancang produk nan sukses, sementara Il-young bekerja di suatu perusahaan pinjaman. Mereka bertemu saat Chi-ho mencoba membayar hutang kakaknya. Kebetulan membuat mereka menjadi dekat.

programme.title: Ditto
programme.desc: Ditto mengisahkan seorang mahasiswa teknik di sebuah universitas bernama Kim Yong. Dia mulai masuk kuliah tahun 1995, namun harus cuti hingga tahun 1999 karena menjalani wajib militer. Suatu hari, Yong menemukan sebuah radio antik yang bisa terhubung dengan masa depan. Yong berkomunikasi dengan Kim Mu-Nee, seorang mahasiswi yang hidup dimasa sekarang, berkuliah di jurusan sosiologi. Komunikasi dari dua periode berbeda ini membuat kisah hidup mereka terungkap satu sama lain.

programme.title: The Favor
programme.desc: Sebuah film okultisme tentang perjuangan sebuah keluarga untuk melepaskan diri dari kutukan mengerikan yang diberikan kepada mereka sebagai imbalan atas sebuah mukjizat yang sangat mereka dambakan.

programme.title: Second Sister
programme.desc: Setelah adiknya bunuh diri akibat fitnah dan komentar jahat di dunia maya, So-eun bersama detektif Jun-kyung mengungkap kebenaran di balik kasus yang melibatkan akun-akun anonim.

programme.title: Peninsula (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang 4 tahun setelah film "Train To Busan." Masyarakat di semenanjung Korea Selatan yang selamat dari kehancuran, berjuang untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: The Swindlers (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Sekelompok sekutu yang tak terduga dari berbagai latar belakang hukum harus bekerja sama untuk mencapai tujuan bersama: menangkap penipu legendaris paling terkenal di dunia.

programme.title: The Old Woman With The Knife (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh bayaran tua yang mahir menyingkirkan penjahat terburuk di masyarakat bertemu dengan seorang anak didik muda yang bersemangat untuk mempelajari keahlian tersebut. Saat mereka menjalin ikatan yang tak terduga, pembunuh veteran itu menemukan tujuan baru di masa senja hidupnya yang penuh kekerasan dan rutinitas.

programme.title: Once We Were Us
programme.desc: Dua mantan kekasih bertemu kembali dalam penerbangan ke Korea, yang membangkitkan kenangan akan pertemuan tak terduga mereka pada tahun 2008, ketika mereka menemukan cinta di tengah hiruk-pikuk Seoul sebelum kehidupan memisahkan mereka.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: Seorang pria yang menjadi tersangka kasus pembunuhan mencari bantuan dari seorang pengacara untuk membuktikan bahwa ia tidak bersalah. Saat mereka mulai mengumpulkan bukti-bukti, kebenaran pun perlahan terkuak.

programme.title: Streaming
programme.desc: Mengikuti seorang streamer misteri dengan jumlah pelanggan terbanyak, yang menyiarkan proses mengungkap petunjuk kasus pembunuhan berantai yang belum terpecahkan secara langsung.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The latest innovations in the automotive industry have been presented in Paris since 1898. This makes the Paris Motor Show the oldest trade fair in the world and provides an insight into the automotive world of tomorrow. One attempt by manufacturers is to replace the traditional combustion engine with alternative drives. Mercedes-Benz founded the Generation EQ sub-brand specifically for this purpose. Under the slogan "think new", Volkswagen wants to introduce 20 new electric models by 2020 and finally put the diesel scandal behind it. In addition to the drive of the future, Perfect Ride presents the manufacturers' design visions. (Station info).

programme.title: Rear view mirror
programme.desc: The highlights from all eras of automobile history: When the brand new Mercedes A-Class fell over in the moose test, when Stirling Moss won the Mille Miglia in record time, when Ferdinand Porsche amazed the world with an electric car in 1900. Exciting images show the viewer what really happened. Contemporary witnesses report on their experiences. Rearview mirror puts the NSU Ro 80 in the spotlight today. With its revolutionary aerodynamic body and its new engine technology, a Wankel engine, it caused a sensation when it first appeared in 1967. (Station info).

programme.title: A&E

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Assistance systems that are normal in cars usually seem exotic or even unthinkable on two-wheelers. However, this no longer applies to the blind spot warning system, which BMW is now offering for the first time. Ideal for the dense traffic in big cities, the home territory of the new maxi scooter C 650 GT. We test the new 60 hp large scooter including the assistance system in Valencia and find out in heavy rush hour traffic whether Side View Assist is an annoying paternalism - or perhaps a real help that could soon also come to motorcycles. (Station info).

programme.title: Mission Mobility
programme.desc: A container on a gravel lot, surrounded by a colorful mix of used cars, some still in good condition, others a little polished, the previous owner has already left his fingerprint here. programme.title: Isle of Man Tourist Trophy

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: For the first time, it was possible to look over the shoulders of the developers for five years. From the idea to the finished car. After a design competition, eight models are shortlisted. Eight comparable vehicles will be presented to 500 test customers. A jury will propose two of the models for the final. The last big design decision has been made. Today there is a winner. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: How will we transport goods and people in the future? The pack mules on our roads are also evolving and moving with the times. VW is working with Ford to save costs and pool expertise on the new van. At Volvo, safety has always been a priority – and that also applies to its trucks. And 5 exciting facts about the Mercedes eCitaro NMC4. (Station info).

programme.title: Dream Cars
programme.desc: Whether Jaguar F-Type, Aston Martin Vanquish Volante or Bentley Continental, English convertibles are elegant and exclusive and, they are fun. English convertibles enjoy cult status all over the world because, after all, the fun of open and fast two-seaters was invented in England. English roadsters offer more sporting spirit than any other, equipped with power, luxury and elegance, they are the most fascinating convertibles of all. Rolls Royce Phantom Drophead, Jaguar F-Type or Aston Martin Vanquish Volante, Dream Cars presents the most breathtaking English convertibles of all time. (Station info).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The US brand Cadillac from Detroit stands for the American way of drive and exuberant luxury made in the USA. The Cadillac Series 62 Convertible from 1949 was the first US car to have the famous and often quoted tail fins. A beefy V8 engine, automatic transmission and electric top are a given for a Caddy of this era. Classic Ride revives the American Way of Drive with the tailfin monster. (Station info).
